purpose: Define explicit physical persistence bindings for DWH instance/schema data while keeping storage engine, path and file layout separate from canonical data identity and ownership.

value.binding_rule: Each persisted DWH scope binds to an explicit storage profile/backend identity.
value.scope_rule: Storage binding references exact owning instance/schema/data scope.
value.identity_rule: File path, table name, bucket, database or engine object is a physical binding and never canonical semantic identity.
value.backend_rule: Backend type/profile/version is explicit where behavior affects semantics.
value.migration_rule: Changing storage backend/binding is an explicit migration operation.
value.ownership_rule: Storage backend never becomes owner of domain semantics by persistence.
value.availability_rule: Storage availability and data authorization remain distinct.
value.failure_rule: Missing/unavailable storage fails explicitly rather than silently switching backend unless a declared failover profile exists.
